TREATMENT OF PANIC DISORDER
Treatment Goals
- Reduce intensity and frequency of attacks
- Reduce anticipatory anxiety

Non-drug Treatment
- Cognitive-behavioural therapy
Drug Treatment
- Fluoxetine
- Adult: initially 20 mg orally once daily, increased after two weeks (if
necessary) to 20 - 60 mg once daily (maximum 80 mg)
- Elderly: 20 - 40 mg (maximum 60 mg for elderly) once daily
- Discontinue in both adults and elderly if no improvement within 10
weeks in both adults and eld
- Child and adolescent under 18 years: not recommended
Or:
- Amitriptyline 50 - 150 mg orally/day
Supportive Measures
- Psychotherapy, Relaxation techniques
Notable Adverse Drug Reactions, Contraindications and Caution
- Tricyclic antidepressants are cardio-toxic in overdose
- Increased risk of suicidal attempts by patients with panic disorder
Prevention
- No specific primary prevention measures
